# AI Paste Cleaner

> Reveal and safely remove invisible Unicode and typographic substitutions from pasted text, while keeping emoji, multilingual text, and legitimate punctuation intact. Runs in the browser and as a zero-dependency command line tool on npm.

## Tool

- [AI Paste Cleaner](https://jaydenyoonzk.github.io/ai-paste-cleaner/): the browser tool, a static page that runs entirely on the visitor's device with no accounts and no data collection
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ai-paste-cleaner): the same engine as a CLI (`npx ai-paste-cleaner`) for files, folders, pipes, and CI gates, plus an importable ES module
- [Machine-readable ruleset](https://jaydenyoonzk.github.io/ai-paste-cleaner/data/rules.json): every detection rule and confusable mapping as JSON

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/JaydenYoonZK/ai-paste-cleaner#readme): what the tool does, how it works, and its engineering notes
